This addon is mainly targeted at streamers to prevent being sniped in open world pvp.
It will obfuscate or hide player names in the default blizzard interface:
* TargetFrame and Target of Target names are replaced with class names
* nameplate player names are replaced with class names
* Tooltip when mouseover a player is replaced with class names
* Names above ANY unit (npc or player) is obfuscated and each letter is replaced with the Ω-Symbol (Omega)
Thanks to Hydra this addon was developed, as he was being sniped a lot.
